company_items.note: J.B. Hunt publishes no non-GAAP reconciliation. These are the items the company itself quantified in its earnings releases (pre-tax, charge + / benefit -). The model bridges adjust only for these. Named but NOT adjusted (not quantified at the consolidated level or operating in nature): Q2-09 ~$4.3m DCS contract start-up costs; Q4-09 ~$3.3m pretax gain on transactions (net ~$0.2m after tax); Q4-16 ~$5m of corporate charges ("approximately"); Q2-13 abandoned shared-technology write-offs and a $1.5m derailment loss (segment commentary only); Q2-21 $3.2m claims-settlement benefit (FMS commentary); 2023 insurance items in other quarters.

outlook_2026.note: J.B. Hunt gives no revenue or earnings guidance. Company statements filed on EDGAR: "We expect our 2026 full year annual tax rate to be approximately 24.0%" (Q3-26 release, 15-Oct-2026); "We expect to spend approximately $700 million for net capital expenditures during the full calendar year 2026" (Q3-26 10-Q, 23-Oct-2026). No guidance from outside EDGAR is used.

debt.at_2026_09_30: 30-Sep-2026 (Q3-26 10-Q Note 4): senior credit facility $379.3m ($81.9m revolver + $300m term loans due Nov-2028, average rate 4.85%); $750m 4.90% senior notes due March 2030 (carrying $744.5m). $1.0bn revolver expiring Nov-2030. The $700m 3.875% senior notes were repaid at maturity in March 2026.
